Do these steps for me. Make sure to use /adversarial to find and fix any issues before running any experiments. Make sure to run the experiments on tmux on whichever GPUs are free. When the experiments are running, don't wait for the results. THanks!

### 1. Preserve this attempt as failed

Do not reinterpret its Stage A as passing. Create a new protocol version, since the current
overlap rule was frozen and operated correctly as written.

### 2. Redesign the overlap gate

A better prospective rule would distinguish boilerplate from substantive reuse:

- Block exact full-document hashes.
- Apply document-level 5-gram Jaccard only to sufficiently long documents.
- Treat sentence overlap as blocking only when, for example:
      - the sentence has at least 10–20 lexical tokens; or
      - multiple matching passages collectively exceed a frozen token/fraction threshold.

- Record short headings and conversational fragments as boilerplate diagnostics rather than
  hard failures.

- Use document-frequency/IDF weighting so “Steps” and “Buy” carry little evidence.
- Validate the rule on planted duplicates and unrelated corpora before applying it to
  another candidate source.

### 3. Decide whether to retain AMALGUM

Two defensible paths:

- Preferred: choose a new corpus from different source domains and preferably a different
  annotation pipeline.

- Possible but weaker: preregister a revised overlap protocol and reevaluate the unchanged
  AMALGUM split. Because AMALGUM content and collision patterns have now been exposed, this
  would no longer be a pristine source-selection attempt and must be reported accordingly.

### 4. Repair the remaining prescore implementation

Before rebuilding Stage A:

- implement strict CoNLL-U/entity parsing;
- replace placeholder prefix-task support with actual generated examples;
- calculate support across discovery, calibration, C1, and C2;
- construct all four sets of 500 maps and their finite-pass matrices;
- bind the full model, tokenizer, checkpoint, environment, endpoint, and inference closure;
- implement digest-based Stage-B QA and signed authorization/nonce handling;
- add behavioral failure-path tests.
